title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Guarantee Clause — Personal Guarantee and the Size of a Credit Line Increase
content:
A principal's personal guarantee on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account enlarges a credit line increase. The line increase is set from the core line increase — the increase worked on the current credit line, its percentage and any multiplication of that product — by the personal guarantee and the account's age:

| A principal's personal guarantee on file | Account open | Line increase |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | At least 60 whole months | The core line increase multiplied by the guarantee share of 1.10 |
| Yes | Less than 60 whole months | The core line increase plus the guarantee addition of 2500.00, a flat amount |
| No | Any | The core line increase, unchanged |

Whether a guarantee is on file is shown on the account record. Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the decision date. The line increase so set is the figure added to the current line before the new line is rounded down to the tier's rounding increment.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: core line increase 4000.00 on a current line of 16000.00, Commercial Account Net 30)

| Guarantee | Account open | Line increase | Current line plus increase |
|---|---|---|---|
| On file | 72 months | 4000.00 times 1.10, 4400.00 | 20400.00 |
| On file | 30 months | 4000.00 plus 2500.00, 6500.00 | 22500.00 |
| Not on file | 72 months | 4000.00 | 20000.00 |

The flat 2500.00 is added after the core line increase has been worked out in full; it is not itself multiplied.
